title: Ears
description: Settings of the ears (the room's ear and every call's ear), host layer: <root>/ears/ears.json. The keeper reads it every loop; each capture reads stt as it starts. Written by hand, by `ears services install`, or by the settings app. A settings screen can be drawn from this schema alone: titles label the controls, a boolean is a switch, an anyOf of titled consts is a picker.

$schema.description: This schema's name, when the file names it.

listen.title: Listening
listen.description: The room's ear on or off. Off stops the capture; nothing is heard until it is on again.

input.title: Input
input.description: 'default' follows the Mac's default input; one input's exact name pins the ears to it.

stt.title: Engine
stt.description: What both ears transcribe with: an OpenAI-compatible /v1 URL and the model it should load. A change restarts the room's capture; a call takes it at the next call.

^_.description: A note for people (why a value is what it is, who set it); never read by the ears.
